caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical black container with a conical top, placed vertically in the center of the composition. Next to it, on the right, is a detached, round lid that matches the container in color and texture. The black container has a decorative design on its front, featuring a central, round, reddish-orange object with detailed yellow markings at the top and large green leaves at the base, suggestive of a stylized fruit or floral motif. Additional yellow patterns, resembling branches with small leaves, encircle the upper part of the container. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned. At the bottom right of the image, the name "C.W. Dawson" is inscribed in black text.
title: Toleware Tin Tea Caddy
